short_scenes.caption: Zor was waiting.
short_scenes.narration: Leo was tied beside a fire. Zor stood over him, club in hand. He had been waiting.

short_scenes.caption: Spear against club.
short_scenes.narration: John charged. Spear against club. Strength against rage.

short_scenes.caption: John fell.
short_scenes.narration: Zor was stronger. John fell hard, his old wound tearing open.

short_scenes.caption: Zor raised the club…
short_scenes.narration: Zor raised his club for the final blow.
